title: Which attachment releases more?
statement:
In the course convention, atom X has EA=−340 kJ/mol and atom Y has EA=−120 kJ/mol. Which gaseous attachment releases more energy?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both signs indicate release in the stated convention.

hints: X has the more negative value.
solution: Negative EA is exothermic here. Compare magnitudes of released energy. X has the more negative value. The magnitude is 340 kJ/mol.
